title: Presenting a document in the room — inspecting the shared screen and one supplied datum
titleEs: Presentación de una prueba en sala — Inspección de un detalle
motif: Presentación de una prueba en sala
description: The plan of a generic hearing room after the presentation: the enlarged copy of a fictional sheet on the shared screen, the presenter at the lectern. A lens opens beside the plan on a real enlarged copy of the screen and the supplied datum under it; one datum is substituted — whether the document is shown on the screen, or the title shown on it — and only its dependent geometry follows. The old value stays traceable as “was: …”, the lens closes and a neutral Δ marks the changed datum. Nothing about admissibility, weight or rulings is shown.

content.note: Visual illustration only. It does not state the law of any jurisdiction or decide validity, responsibility or outcomes.

license: Original vector artwork and code created for this project; no third-party assets.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

building.description: Name printed under the generic building (fictional)

room.description: Name of the room drawn as a plan (fictional)

courts.description: Generic, fictional building and hearing room (no real court, building shape or emblem)

label.description: Editable label of the participant at this place (as supplied)

seats.description: Participants and their places, as supplied: front = behind the bench; left1/left2 and right1/right2 = the two tables. Every listed place is drawn with its editable label; a place carries no legal meaning (array replaces the previous value)

routes.description: Presentation order (as supplied), as seat indices: the first listed participant seated at a table carries the document to the lectern; the others look towards the shared screen in this order. Seats not listed are still drawn and keep facing the front; unknown or repeated indices are ignored (array replaces the previous value)

document.description: Short fictional title of the document (no real case data)

camera.description: Caption of the lectern with the document camera

key.description: Neutral key shown with the labels (must say that no conclusion is drawn)

appearance.description: Optional appearance overrides; defaults derive from the seed (never tied to a role)

people.description: Optional appearance of each seat’s person, in seat order (array replaces the previous value)

focusTarget.description: Datum that is substituted: display = whether the document is shown on the shared screen (the copy leaves the screen, which goes to stand-by); document = the title of the document shown on the screen (the title and the page change). Values as supplied

beforeValue.description: Value shown before the substitution, in its own chip under the screen

afterValue.description: Value shown after the substitution (the alternative datum), in the same chip

zoom.description: Largest magnification of the lens, relative to the plan at rest

placement.description: Where the lens sits: auto (beside the plan where the panel is), or beside / above it

labels.key: Places and labels as supplied · no conclusion drawn

defaultParams.beforeValue: Shown on the shared screen (as supplied)
defaultParams.afterValue: Not shown on the shared screen (as supplied)

contextLabels.context: The room after the presentation, as supplied
